source_panel_hashing_rule: The executable must hash the exact raw bytes read from source_panel_path using SHA-256; do not hard-code a digest for normalized/re-serialized JSON.
subset_enumeration: all subsets, including the empty set, of the four frozen training scenarios
held_out_evaluation: evaluate all four unchanged held-out stress scenarios for every subset
claim_ceiling: Synthetic finite-panel sensitivity only; subset rows are not independent samples, probabilities, confidence intervals, or real-world risk estimates.
